QuestInfo.name: [Hero Squad] Immortal Gorgons Week 1 Rewards
QuestInfo.0:
#b#eHero Squad: Immortal Gorgons#n#k
We're giving out Adventure Coins to heroes who have challenged the Immortal Gorgons for at least 30 minutes each week. Their rewards will depend on rank, but everyone will come away with something!

Top  1% - 5%: Adventure Coin x450 + 30 for each additional 1%
Top  6% - 10%: Adventure Coin x350 + 20 for each additional 1%
Top 11% - 20%: Adventure Coin x250 + 10 for each additional 1%
Top 21% - 40%: Adventure Coin x150 + 5 for each additional 1%
Top 41% - 60%: Adventure Coin x90 + 3 for each additional 1%
Top 61% - 80%: Adventure Coin x30 + 2 for each additional 1%
Top 81% - 100%: Adventure Coin x10 + 1 for each additional 1%

#bWeek 1 Progression Period#k
07/24/2019 00:00 - 07/30/2019 23:59

#bWeek 1 Reward Claim Period#k
07/31/2019 10:00 - 08/06/2019 23:59

(If you forfeit or didn't score, the challenge time will not be recorded. Rewards can only be claimed once per world.)
